title: Essence, the signature view
done: Named and asked for by the author: the chain seen, not read. A project lands on one page - the opening of its idea, its path, each step with what delivers and proves it (or nothing yet), and what is happening now - a flow of four numbered steps; four marks say how completely it tells its essence. A lens may show the same for its subject.
considered: A fifth tab beside the others.
rejected: That: it is the landing; the other tabs are detail behind it.

title: Lenses of ideas
done: The view kinds ideas and log drawn (they were declared, not built); a lens with no candidates to compare shows its path and what its work says, with no empty comparison sections - needed by the Mnemonic Vocabulary lens, a project still at the idea stage.

title: It tells its essence
done: Its idea written for anyone, and its workings: what delivers and proves each step of its path, and why we care. Steps that nothing serves yet are left empty, to be seen.
rejected: That: a step nothing serves is a wish, and should show.

title: Not yet is not failure
done: Seen on a project at the idea stage: every planned item showed the red sign of broken things. Planned work not yet started now has its own calm sign (an empty circle, grey) and a not-started milestone a grey ring; red stays for what is really broken or missing.
considered: Leaving red for open backlog items.
rejected: That: it painted an idea as a failure.

title: Criteria in their own project; discovered lenses
done: A milestone's criteria are read in its own project first, then anywhere - needed once a path (Rhizoid's) read another project's backlog on purpose; lenses the observatory finds but does not curate are shown under their own heading.
considered: Requiring a project prefix on every criterion.
rejected: That: own-first reads naturally, and chaining stays one word.

title: Four things only eyes found
done: Looking at screenshots of the Russian pages: unknown cells read as blank (the faint dot is now a clear ?); the table's first column was named from a table name (the lens names its rows); categories came in an arbitrary order (the lens orders its groups, by the source category so it holds in every language); the milestone cards' chips were English (now messages). A second look showed the question marks white on pale: the table's "cell text is white" rule outranked the pale cells' own - the real cause of the invisible sign; their rule now outranks it, with a test.
rejected: That: a question mark says unknown without a legend.

title: From a first site to ocoeco's rendering engine
done: The site, the path, a page per project, made by work, grand views drawn from lenses, one site per language with Fluent catalogs, each project's own data translations; the mark, discovery and harvest moved out to ocoeco; renamed ocoeco-engine.
considered: Depending on ocoeco's code; restructuring every formatting call for messages; translating rendered pages.
rejected: Hard-coded grand views; unknown counted as failure; readiness from any done milestone; a lens translating other projects' data.

title: The idea, as an article
done: Said by the author: the Idea tab told a commoner nothing - terse cards, alphabetical, written about a project rather than by it. A project's idea is now an ordered piece of writing in its own data, shown as an article; a lens opens with the idea of what it is about.
rejected: That: cards name the parts for an insider; an idea is read from the start by someone who knows nothing.

title: Words never overlap
done: The path's labels ran into each other (reported with a screenshot): the path is now page layout - a cell per stop, labels shown whole and wrapping inside their own cell, scrolling sideways when narrow - with a test that forbids words inside SVG.
considered: A longer cut; a smaller font.
rejected: Both: they hide the fault until the next longer title or language.
